query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'observedAt',statement_timestamp()::text,
'staleReceipts',(SELECT count(*) FROM core.command_receipts WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c' AND command_id='92e523de-6d82-d54a-0bfe-e81a78593a96'),
'staleProposals',(SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.cash_date_proposals WHERE tenant_id='babe6c86-a764-4d3a-80a3-952a7c096c2c' AND id='8337ca68-2add-d88a-a198-9019b10235cc'),
'activeCashApiInvocations',(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE usename='authenticator' AND state='active' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid() AND query ~ '(^|[^[:alnum:]_$"])(\"api\"|api)[[:space:]]*[.][[:space:]]*(\"wave5_cash_date_command\"|wave5_cash_date_command)[[:space:]]*[(]' AND position('pg_stat_activity' in query)=0)) AS observation
